hotels.title: All-Inclusive Los Cabos Beachfront Retreat with 12 Restaurants & Bars, Four Swimming Pools & Day Spa
hotels.description: Experience the sun-drenched allure of Los Cabos with an enchanting all-inclusive oceanside retreat overlooking the shimmering Gulf of California. Soak up the warmth of the Mexican sun, dip your toes in powder-soft sands and spend your days splashing around one of the resort’s four pools, including an adults-only pool. Be pampered with treatments at Eternity Spa and keep the little ones engaged with a plethora of fun activities at the onsite kids’ and teens’ clubs. Prepare for countless gastronomic treats across 12 restaurants and bars, serving up enticing delicacies from around the world. Take advantage of all-inclusive perks: catch sunsets with cocktails and crispy tacos in hand, then immerse yourself in the resort’s carnivalesque spirit with themed parties by night.
